subtasks: Arrange the numbers from left to right to form the largest possible number, and place them on the pad.
Place the remaining digit 1 upright on the fourth, rightmost pad. Leave 9, 5, and 3 in place, then open both grippers and return both arms to their initial poses.

Set the held 1 flat on the clear tabletop directly below the left gripper, open it and retract the left arm. Then use the right gripper to place 1 upright on the empty fourth pad and return both open arms to their start poses.
